items.title: Tech stocks surge as Nvidia rally adds $2 trillion to Nasdaq 100
items.summary: US technology stocks staged a broad rally Monday, with gains across chipmakers, AI infrastructure providers and software companies adding nearly $2 trillion to the Nasdaq 100's market capitalization as investors welcomed Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD). items.title: Micron Stock Jumps 18%. Why the Rally Has Legs.
items.summary: Don’t call it a comeback just yet, but the memory-chip maker is finally showing signs of life following a brutal selloff.

items.title: Investors Might Be Underestimating Seagate’s Long-Term AI Growth Opportunity
items.summary: Seagate's stock has already doubled this year, then slid hard in a single month. Wall Street still sees a path to far higher, and one number the CEO calls his North Star may explain why.

items.title: Dell Stock Jumps 20% as AI Hardware Rallies on Nvidia CEO News on Nov. 23
items.summary: Dell shares rose 20.4% as AI hardware stocks rallied after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.

items.title: SanDisk Surges 22% as Jensen Huang’s Return to NVIDIA Sparks AI Chip Rebound; Seagate Jumps 18%, Micron Rallies 16%
items.summary: A boardroom reversal at NVIDIA just yanked memory stocks off the mat, and the flash maker with the steepest losses is bouncing hardest. But the same board's about-face may be exactly what bears should worry about.

items.title: SK Hynix Soars 8%, Sandisk Up 6% as Memory Stocks Rebound From AI Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix’s US shares rose 21% as memory and storage stocks, Sandisk and Seagate among them, bounced back from last week’s AI sell-off. No company news drove it: Taiwan and South Korea moved to support their markets.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Seagate (STX) on Thursday
items.summary: ETFs sold a net $81.7 million of Seagate Technology Holdings PLC (STX) on Nov. 19.

items.title: U.S. chip and neocloud stocks rally premarket after last week’s selloff
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. chip and neocloud stocks surged in premarket trading Monday, rebounding from a rout that gave the Nasdaq its worst week since 2020.
